source_description: Preserve the original complete rifle paint atlas: broad warmbrown wood-colored paint left and across the center, with its original broad dark upperleft shadow and weak old grain. Keep the ONE narrow original gray vertical paint mark in the leftwood around native x31..37,y22..34 as that exact indistinct shaded mark with its weak internal pixels, not a new letter/badge or detailed fastener. Preserve the original tiny pale fleck nearx18,y30 and the soft central pale/dark dot nearx110,y43 with unchanged contour/localstrength. Keep the original gray framed field upperright, smaller gray field/cutout uppermiddle, original pale gray horizontal fields right, lower-middle framed gray panel and lower-right pale panel/adjacent narrow strips. All original fine stripes, tiny spots and dark gaps remain exact count/phase; vague source shading remains vague. Woodpaint stays subdued warmbrown with broad washed gradients; gray stays softly painted steel-colored gray, without newly sharp engraved surfaces or raised hardware.
